criteria.name: QUALIFIER_PRESERVATION
criteria.failure_condition: A material source condition, uncertainty statement, limitation, or qualifier is silently dropped, strengthened, or weakened during decomposition.

criteria.name: RECOMMENDATION_NONPROMOTION
criteria.failure_condition: A source recommendation acquires technical-confirmation standing, repair-authority standing, or is represented as an adopted Fork action without a separate bridge.

criteria.name: COORDINATE_RELATION_SEPARATION
criteria.failure_condition: The review-observed coordinate and a later evaluation-target coordinate are conflated, or an unresolved review coordinate is silently replaced by a pinned evaluation coordinate.

criteria.name: UNRESOLVED_STANDING_PRESERVATION
criteria.failure_condition: An unresolved coordinate, unverified technical standing, or source limitation is omitted from a required downstream representation.

criteria.name: CLASSIFICATION_ATTRIBUTION_BOUNDARY
criteria.failure_condition: A Fork-derived classification, taxonomy, or boundary label is attributed to the reviewer without source support.

criteria.name: SOURCE_MAPPING_RECOMPUTABILITY
criteria.failure_condition: A source-derived assertion lacks a recomputable byte-span mapping to frozen SOURCE-REVIEW-001 or materially misstates the mapped passage.

criteria.name: DOWNSTREAM_STANDING_PRESERVATION
criteria.failure_condition: A required downstream summary or rendering materially changes the standing recorded in the canonical assertion register.

criteria.name: TECHNICAL_NONTECHNICAL_SCOPE_SEPARATION
criteria.failure_condition: A nontechnical evaluation or recommendation is forced into technical reproduction standing without a separately decomposed technical proposition.

criteria.name: SOURCE_IMMUTABILITY
criteria.failure_condition: The canonical SOURCE-REVIEW-001 payload is altered after freeze rather than superseded by a separately identified successor source event.

completion_rule: Evaluate every required criterion against the canonical records and required downstream rendering after ASSERTION-REGISTER-001 is instantiated.
non_claims: Criteria freeze does not establish Experiment B success.
Procedure completion does not establish Experiment B success.
Experiment A result does not determine Experiment B result.
